chunks: And Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from al-Sadiq, from his father, peace be upon them, who said:
“The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, had a staff with a pointed end. He would lean upon it, and he would bring it out on the two Eids and pray toward it.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eid festivals, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.عَنَزَةٌ: a short staff or spear-like stick
key_terms.عُكَّازٌ: a pointed ferrule or lower tip of the staff
key_terms.يُصَلِّي إِلَيْهَا: he would perform salat (prayer) facing toward it

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم use in front of him during the Eid prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم during the prayers of the two Eids. It reports that he used a staff and would place it before himself while praying, indicating a Prophetic practice related to the manner of performing prayer in an open space.
